description: Healthcare graph analytics agent powered by the Healthcare_Demo_Ontology_HLS ontology. Navigates patient care pathways through entity lookups and relationship traversals across 11 entity types (Patient, Provider, Encounter, Claim, Prescription, Diagnosis, Medication, Payer, PatientDiagnosis, CommunityHealth, MedicationAdherence) connected by 17 relationships. Ideal for tracing care journeys, finding connected entities, checking medication adherence, and understanding clinical and financial relationships.
